heading: Which Kingdom Would Claim You?
intro: Seven kingdoms. Seven sacred animals. And the Owl, which belongs to none. Answer eight questions and discover where you belong in K'Thari.
shareText: The kingdoms have spoken. I belong to {beast}. Which kingdom would claim you?

lion.name: Kingdom of the Sun
lion.motto: Where authority is sacred, and crowns are heavy.
lion.you: You were made to carry weight others can't. When the room goes quiet, eyes turn to you, and you don't look away. You believe in order, in duty, and in the hard truth that someone has to decide.

elephant.name: The Land That Remembers
elephant.you: You remember what others forget. You are slow to judge and almost never wrong, and people come to you when they need the long view. To you, the past is not past. It is a teacher.

crocodile.name: The Waiting Waters
crocodile.you: You don't rush. You watch, you wait, and when you finally move, it's already over. People mistake your stillness for calm. It's patience, and patience always wins.

leopard.name: The Hidden Crown
leopard.you: You see what others miss and go where others can't. You work best alone, in the details, out of sight. You don't need credit. You need the job done perfectly.

gorilla.name: The Unbroken Heights
gorilla.motto: Where power is mastered, not displayed.
gorilla.you: Your strength is the kind you rarely have to show. You train in silence, you keep your word, and you don't break. Others shout. You simply hold the line.

serpent.name: The Coiled Dominion
serpent.you: You understand that the right word, at the right moment, is worth more than an army. You notice everything and reveal little. Most wars you'd end before anyone knew they'd started.

hyena.name: The Devouring Lands
hyena.motto: Where survival has rotted into cruelty.
hyena.you: You are a survivor. Life has never handed you anything, so you learned to take your place and keep it. Others see hunger. You see a pack that never abandons its own.

owl.name: The Secret Lands
owl.motto: It has no throne. It watches.
owl.you: Rare. The Owl claims almost no one. You belong to no single crown. You see the whole board, the balance between all seven, and you watch over every one of them.

questions.q: A crisis strikes your homeland. What do you do first?

answers.text: Take command. Someone has to.
Search the old records. This has happened before.
Stay still. Watch. Act only when the moment is certain.
Gather your people and take what you need to survive.

questions.q: Which gift would you ask of the gods?

answers.text: A crown no one dares to question
A memory that never fades
The power to move unseen
Strength that never breaks
Words. The right whisper in the right ear.
Patience
Precision
Hunger. I want it more than anyone.

questions.q: Where do you feel most at home?

answers.text: Sunlit plains below a great palace
Ancient forests where the old ones walk
Dark rivers and hidden deltas
Mist-wrapped mountain heights

questions.q: A rival insults you in public. You…

answers.text: Answer calmly. You never need to raise your voice.
Smile. They'll regret it, eventually.
Vanish. By morning you know everything about them.
Strike back now, with your whole pack behind you.

questions.q: What would people say about you?

answers.text: Born to lead
Wise beyond their years
Impossible to read
A survivor. Nothing keeps them down.

questions.q: Night falls over K'Thari. You are…

answers.text: Moving through the shadows on a mission
Training in silence while others sleep
Watching the stars, reading what they foretell
Resting beside still water, eyes half open

questions.q: What matters most in the end?

answers.text: That the realm stands as one
That I held the secret that decided everything
Balance. No single crown should rule them all.
That my people never go hungry again
